questions_and_answers.question: When you want to know who the caller is, what expression do you use?

answers.answer: Shitsuree desu ga, donata desu ka? (Excuse me, but who is calling?)

questions_and_answers.question: What is 'Shitsuree desu ga, donata desu ka?' comparable to in English?
If the caller is a friend of yours or your husband/wife's, what might happen?

answers.answer: S/he may skip a step or use less formal expressions
S/he must use the most formal expressions

questions_and_answers.question: Instead of asking '...san no otaku desu ka?', what may the caller do?

answers.answer: Ask immediately for the person s/he wants

questions_and_answers.question: What might the caller say instead of '...san irasshaimasu ka?'
Since you can't accurately predict what the caller will say, what can you use whenever you have difficulty?

answers.answer: Familiar expressions like 'Nihongo ga yoku wakarimasen.'

questions_and_answers.question: What does 'Nihongo ga yoku wakarimasen' mean?
What does 'Moo sukoshi yukkuri itte kudasaimasen ka?' mean?
What does 'Moo ichi-do yukkuri itte kudasaimasen ka?' mean?
What does the expression '...san desu ne?' mean?

articles.text:
2. How to answer a call

What has been discussed above also applies when you answer a call.

When you want to know who the caller is, you can use the following expression, which is comparable to 'May I ask who is calling?' in English:

Shitsuree desu ga, donata desu ka?    Excuse me, but who is calling?

If the caller is a friend of yours or your husband/wife's, s/he may skip a step or use less formal expressions. For example, the person may not ask ...san no otaku desu ka? but instead ask immediately for the person s/he wants. S/he may also say ...-san onegai shimasu 'Mr./Mrs..., please' rather than ...-san irasshaimasu ka?

At any rate, although the general procedure is relatively routine, you can't accurately predict what the caller will say. Therefore, whenever you have difficulty, you can use the following familiar expressions:

Nihongo ga yoku wakarimasen.              I don't understand Japanese well.
Moo sukoshi yukkuri itte kudasaimasen ka?  Please say it more slowly.
Moo ichi-do yukkuri itte kudasaimasen ka?  Please repeat slowly.
...san desu ne?                           It's ...isn't it?
